layman_headline: Market fear is easing but no new opportunities stand out — holding current positions.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is still in a fearful mood, but sentiment has improved from 31 to 41 over the past day, which is a positive sign. Our two current positions — Solana and Chainlink — are both slightly underwater (about 1-2% loss each) but well within their stop-loss ranges. The swing trade candidates available today are either stablecoins, already-extended movers, or lack enough technical data to build a confident trade around.
layman_action: Hold your current SOL and LINK positions. Both are early in their trades and haven't hit stop-losses. Wait for better setups with clearer technical signals before adding new positions.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate pool is weak this cycle. VELVET dropped 46% in 24h despite being up 27% weekly — extreme volatility with RSI at 60 is a red flag, not an opportunity. MON has a decent RSI at 39 but lacks any catalyst, MACD data, or volume confirmation. FIL is down 12.9% weekly and 99.7% from ATH with no RSI or technical data available — catching a falling knife without indicators. Stablecoins (FDUSD, USDG, RLUSD) and gold-backed XAUT offer no swing trade potential. SOL and LINK both entered recently and are within normal drawdown ranges. BTC dominance at 56.6% continues to suppress alt performance, but the Fear & Greed improvement from 31→41 suggests the worst of the recent fear may be passing.
risk_factors: BTC dominance at 56.6% continues to drain capital from alts, limiting upside for SOL and LINK
Fear & Greed still at 41 — market could easily slide back into deeper fear on any negative catalyst
Both positions are slightly negative; a broader market downturn could trigger stop-losses simultaneously
watch_list: Fear & Greed index — if it crosses 50 into neutral, alts could catch a bid and accelerate our exits
LINK price action around $9.50-$9.60 resistance — a break above confirms the weekly uptrend continuation
BTC holding $64K support — if BTC breaks down, alt positions will face amplified selling pressure
market_context: Market is in a fearful but improving state (F&G 41, up from 31 yesterday). BTC is relatively flat at $64K with high dominance at 56.6%, creating a challenging environment for alt-coin swing trades.
context_banner: Sentiment is recovering from deep fear but alt conditions remain unfavorable — patience is the best trade today.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed improved from 31 to 41 in one day, suggesting a sentiment bottom may be forming, but not yet actionable for new entries.
MON RSI at 39 is the only near-oversold candidate, but lacks MACD, volume, and catalyst data to justify entry.
LINK up 12% on the week but pulling back 1.2% daily — classic consolidation pattern that supports holding rather than adding.
US Treasury advancing GENIUS Act stablecoin rules and OCC approving Trump family crypto trust charter signal regulatory progress, but no direct alt catalyst.
Solana treasury firm's aggressive share restructuring adds headline risk but no direct price impact to SOL token at this stage.
